content.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Task Force Members

entries.declaration_summary: Academic research grants from NIHR and other research bodies; involvement in multiple research programmes and industry collaborations (Bayer, Novartis, Servier, HYVE, Vifor, Roche, MedicineMan, Microlife); participation in EU/EFPIA Innovative Medicines Initiative and other funding programmes; fellowships panel for Wellcome Trust.
entries.full_text_excerpt: Any other interest (financial or otherwise) that should be declared in view of holding an ESC position... Academic research grants from the National Institute for Health Research (NIHR CDF-2015-08-074 RATE-AF; NIHR130280 DaRe2THINK; NIHR132974 D2T-NeuroVascular; NIHR203326 Biomedical Research Centre), the British Heart Foundation (PG/17/55/33087, AA/18/2/34218 and FS/CDRF/21/21032), the EU/EFPIA Innovative Medicines Initiative (BigData@Heart 116074); including industry collaboration from Bayer, Novartis, Servier, the HYVE and Vifor; EU Horizon and UKRI (HYPERMARKER 101095480); including industry collaboration from Roche, MedicineMan and Microlife; UK National Health Service - Data for R&D - Subnational Secure Data Environment programme; UK Dept. for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy Regulators Pioneer Fund; and the Cook & Wolstenholme Charitable Trust. Fellowships panel for the Wellcome Trust (London).
